updates.title: Word Hints on Every Deck Page
updates.description: Player jargon on the deck pages now explains itself. Words like starter, extender, handtrap, end board, floodgate, GY and OTK get a dotted underline: hover, tab to or tap one to see what it means in a sentence, with a link to its full entry in the Beginner's Guide glossary. Each word is marked the first time it comes up in a section, and card names and headings are left alone. Prefer a clean page? The Aa Hints button next to Cards and Synergies turns them off (and back on), and the setting sticks across every deck page.

updates.title: Beginner's Guide - Stop the Combo, Live Banlist Checks and a Swordsoul Lab
updates.description: After the modern turn, Stop the combo puts you in the opponent's seat with Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring, Effect Veiler and Infinite Impermanence: pick which one stops each moment, read why, and jump the simulator to that step. Banlist statuses in the guide are now checked against the current lists when the page loads, and the deck finder notes any Forbidden cards in its suggestions. The Swordsoul page gets the same two-card line in its own combo simulator.

updates.title: Beginner's Guide - A Modern Turn, a Deck Finder and a Cheat Sheet
updates.description: Watch a turn now ends with a real modern combo you can step through: Swordsoul of Mo Ye and Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan become Swordsoul Grandmaster - Chixiao and Swordsoul Sinister Sovereign - Qixing Longyuan, with every step labelled with the word players use for it, from starter and choke point to extender and end board. Your first deck has a deck finder: answer three questions about play style, how much thinking you want and the look you like, and get three decks with pages on this site. A one-page cheat sheet with the turn, Summoning, battle and the 16 starred words prints from the glossary, the start steps and the What to bring list.

updates.title: Beginner's Guide - Shorter Reading Paths
updates.description: Pick Brand new, I play Master Duel or Coming back at the top of the Beginner's Guide, and the sections that aren't on your path fold down to their In short summary, with one tap to open any of them or all of them. On a phone the Master Duel path is now about 21 screens instead of 36. The Lore Archive opens as a short teaser on phones, the chapter bar has a solid backdrop once it sticks, flashcards grow to fit long definitions, glossary groups show counts like 4 of 24 while filtered, and faint text is easier to read.

updates.title: Dark Magician - Combo Simulator Rebuilt from Official Card Text
updates.description: The Dark Magician combo simulator is rebuilt from the official card text, one move per step. One Magician's Rod: Full Backrow is a one-card line through Dark Magical Curtain, Dark Magician of Destruction and Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant that ends on four monsters with Magician's Salvation active and Eternal Soul Set. Illusion of Chaos into Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon Sets The Gaze of Timaeus for your opponent's turn. Going Second: Rod and Souls Banish a Card uses Magicians' Souls and Dark Magical Circle to remove a card. The page's written lines are corrected to match: Dark Magician of Destruction goes to a Main Monster Zone so the Link can use the Extra Monster Zone, Circle's banish targets, and Gaze banishes its Fusion Monster at the end of the following turn.

updates.title: Beginner's Guide - Read a Card, Watch a Turn, Learn the Nicknames
updates.description: The Beginner's Guide gets three new sections. How to read a card puts numbered spots on Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring for its name, Attribute, Level, Type and ATK/DEF, then colour-codes its text into condition, cost and effect. Watch a turn plays a simple first turn and the opponent's reply step by step on a two-sided board: a search, a Normal Summon, a Set Mirror Force and the chain that stops an attack. Card nicknames explains 29 short names players use for popular cards, from Ash and Imperm to DRNM and TTT, with a test-yourself mode. The glossary grows to 125 words with Token, Attribute, monster Type, Quick-Play, Counter Trap and Deck out. Action words can play on the field diagram, each group of words can be practised on its own, the quiz works both ways, and the page remembers which sections you've read.

updates.title: Lore Archive Slideshows - Every Story Told in Card Art
updates.description: The Lore Archive on 195 archetype pages now tells its story in card art. On 97 pages it's a slideshow: each chapter shows the card whose art depicts that moment, in a pixel-art frame with the passage underneath, and one picture turns into the next through a mosaic. You can step through the chapters, pause, click the art to see the card, or read the whole story at once. Where a story has named characters, a Who's who row shows each person as the card they are at that point, so you can see that Diactorus, Vidolium and Mediclius are all Medius. Archetypes whose official lore is a set of character profiles get a roster instead, on 48 pages: pick a person to see their art and profile. Archetypes without an official story get an art trail, on 50 pages: a guided walk through their card artworks, with a note on each one.

updates.title: Lore Archive Music - A Soundtrack for Every Archetype's Story
updates.description: Every Lore Archive slideshow, roster and art trail now has music. Press the speaker in its controls to turn it on: nothing plays or downloads until you do, and the site remembers your choice. The music fits each archetype's world: an orchestra with harp for Artmage, synths and a drum machine for Sky Striker, zither, flute and gongs for Swordsoul, koto, shakuhachi and taiko for Bujin, a harpsichord waltz with tolling bells for Vendread, and sitar, tabla and a drone for Tenyi, plus medieval, sacred, playful and tribal styles for many more. Archetypes that share a style still each get their own key, tempo and chords. The music follows the story as you read: every chapter has its own mood, from calm to battle, and when a passage names a character, their theme plays and their portrait lights up. Hover over a portrait to hear its theme. The music fades out when you scroll away and quiets down when you pause the slideshow.

updates.title: New to Yu-Gi-Oh!? A Beginner's Guide to the Rules and the Jargon
updates.description: A new page for players who are just starting out, in three short chapters: play the game, talk like a duelist, and build and play. It explains 115 pieces of player jargon in plain English, from starter, extender and handtrap to bounce, brick and garnet, and any dotted word on the page shows its meaning where you tap it. You can learn by doing: a battle calculator, a chain you step through one link at a time, a field map where cards fly between zones for actions like bounce and mill, a name-that-frame game with real cards, a decoder that asks you to guess each word in 15 typical player sentences, and flashcards and a quiz that remember which words you know. It also covers how to choose and buy a first deck, where to play online and in person, and how the Banlist works.

updates.title: Ashtra - A New Page for the Face-Down Synchro Shrine
updates.description: A new guide for Ashtra, the ten-card Trap and Synchro theme from Beyond the Brave. Every main-deck Ashtra monster Special Summons itself from the hand by revealing a face-down card you control and taking it back, so one Set card can pay for several Summons. All three Ashtra Traps can Special Summon themselves as Level 1 Tuners and Synchro Summon straight away, which turns your back row into Synchro plays on your opponent's turn. The page covers all ten cards, a 1.5-card Mikumari opener, a First Penguin line, the Susanoo Loop that removes four cards every cycle without targeting, and a chart of which boss each Trap Tuner reaches. It adds deck ratios for pure, Labrynth and Paleozoic builds, the hybrid engines that fix going second, a tier rating, and the counters that hurt the deck most.
newCards: Ashtrashen - Gate to the Worlds Beyond

updates.title: Adamancipator - Conductor Stacks the Deck So Excavation Can't Miss
updates.description: Beyond the Brave gives Adamancipator five cards aimed at its three old problems. Adamancipator Conductor, Mates and Crystal - Tiamite each put a known card on top of the Deck, so the next excavation is guaranteed to hit. Conductor is a Level 6 Tuner that makes Adamancipator Risen - Tiamite with any Level 4 in one Synchro Summon, where the deck used to climb from Level 2 Tuners. From the GY, Crystal - Tiamite returns a used Rock Synchro to the Extra Deck and goes back on top of the Deck, replacing the loop the deck lost with Block Dragon. A new Beyond the Brave tab profiles all five cards and walks through a two-card Conductor line that ends on Risen - Tiamite and a Set Adamancipator Resonance. It also adds a disruption table, recommended copies and the weak points to play around. The original guide stays in the Classic Analysis tab.

updates.title: Elfnote - Three Power Patron Cards Join the Concert
updates.description: Beyond the Brave prints no card named "Elfnote", but three Power Patron cards plug straight into the deck. Ars Magna "Citrinitas" is always treated as an Elfnote card, so Tinia places it from the Deck and it adds a Medius. Theorealized Medius summons itself next to Elfnote Power Patron or Junora and adds a Theorealize card. Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron points down from an Extra Monster Zone at the center zone and the two zones beside it on one side. A new Movement IV tab covers center-zone positioning, Junora's column lock and Plea for Help's Attribute modes, with a stage planner that shows what any board does on your opponent's turn. It adds a search map, Synchro recipes, recovery against common hand traps, a 24-card breakdown with official text, a recommended build and a tier rating. The combo simulator gets four lines: one-card Lucina, the Theorealized Medius bridge into Mediclius, the opponent's-turn rotation, and a going-second break for 9900 ATK.

updates.title: Light and Darkness Ritual - Spell Shattering Sword Brings the Engine's First Negate
updates.description: Beyond the Brave gives the Light and Darkness engine the two things it lacked. Spell Shattering Sword is a Quick-Play that turns a face-up monster to 0 ATK and negates its effects, as long as you can show Light and Darkness Ritual, and Griffoh can Set it for use the same turn. Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity mentions the Ritual, summons itself at Quick-Effect speed by discarding a spare Ritual Spell, and Sets the Sword every time it's Special Summoned. A new Beyond the Brave tab compares the engine before and after, profiles both cards, shows what the Sword can and can't stop, and adds three lines to the combo simulator. A second new tab, Strategic Breakdown, reviews all eleven Chaos Origins cards from their official TCG text, with the Ritual's once-per-turn refill, every way to pay for a Level 8, the search chains for classic Black Luster Soldier and Magician of Black Chaos, a combo flowchart, a threat checker, ratios and a competitive verdict.
updates.link: pages/Light and Darkness Ritual Deck Analysis.html#tab-betb
newCards: Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity

updates.title: Doom-Z - Beyond the Brave's Medius Cards Join the DoomZ Engine
updates.description: Beyond the Brave prints no new DoomZ card, but four of its Medius cards work in Doom-Z. Ars Magna "Citrinitas" is always treated as a DoomZ card: Drastea, Raiders and Doom-Z's own searchers use it, and it adds Medius the Pure. Theorealized Medius calls DoomZ Break - Diactorus from the Extra Deck, Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification returns whenever you Special Summon an Xyz Monster, and Mediclius finishes the turns you skip Raiders. A new Beyond the Brave tab adds the card profiles, a checker for which Doom-Z effects each card satisfies, the Extra Deck locks, a panel for each connected engine, deck slots, and three lines in the combo simulator: a one-card Citrinitas board, a Jupredo and Theorealized Medius board that keeps the Normal Summon, and a Mediclius board. The walkthroughs in the older tabs were also corrected against the card text, and the original simulator line was transcribed again from its replay, one move per step.
newCards: Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification

updates.title: Combo Simulator - Alien, Gladiator Beast and a Second D/D Line
updates.description: Three uploaded replays join the combo simulator, each credited to its uploader. Alien gets its first interactive line: a three-card first-turn kill that loops Premature Burial through Cosmic Fortress Gol'gar, hands your opponent an Ancient Sacred Wyvern pumped to 8500 ATK, and burns them out with Number 33: Chronomaly Machu Mech and Dark Strike Fighter. Gladiator Beast gets a one-card Speedroid Terrortop line into two Claudius and Heraklinos. D/D adds a one-card Fiendsmith Engraver line into Zeus Ragnarok and Deus Machinex; it runs through Spright Elf, which is Forbidden in the TCG.

updates.title: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon - A New Page for the Daedalus Field Spell
updates.description: A dedicated guide to the Beyond the Brave Field Spell that isn't "Umi". It covers each of its three effects, Konami's ruling on what its Link discount allows, and a side-by-side with Umi and A Legendary Ocean: Levels, stats, recursion, and when to play which. It also shows how to swap between them in the one Field Zone. A Field Zone planner shows which classic Umi effects are on for any board, and the combo simulator plays all three Atlantis lines.
updates.link: pages/Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon Deck Analysis.html
updates.featuredCard: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon
newCards: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon

updates.title: Umi - Atlantis & Daedalus Put "Umi" on the Monsters
updates.description: Beyond the Brave gives Umi eleven cards and turns Daedalus into an archetype. Six new monsters and Advent of Atlantis are named "Umi" on the field, so Kairyu-Shin's lock and Electric Jellyfish's negate survive Field Spell removal. The new Field Spell, Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon, cuts a material from Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus and Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage. A new Atlantis & Daedalus tab adds a filterable gallery of all eleven cards, a table of what counts as "Umi" and what survives Rage's sweep, which classic Umi cards still work, a deck list, and three lines in the combo simulator: a two-card Rage board, the Kairyu-Shin lock rebuilt with Advent, and a going-second sweep for 8500.
updates.featuredCard: Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage
newCards: Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage
Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon

updates.title: Gorgonic - Gorgonic Umbral Horror Takes the Family to Rank 4
updates.description: Beyond the Brave prints the first new Gorgonic card in over twelve years, and it's also an Umbral Horror. Gorgonic Umbral Horror summons itself onto an empty field, adds V, Shining or Thousand Umbral Horror, and counts as two materials for Number 104: Masquerade V. V Umbral Horror then ranks Masquerade V up into Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory from the Graveyard, with no Rank-Up-Magic Spell. A new Umbral Horror tab has a card-by-card panel for all five cards, the Rank 4 to Rank 7 boss ladder, a Rank 4 Number toolbox, a table of which classic Gorgonic cards still work, and a checker for what you can still summon while Gorgonic Umbral Horror is face-up (Gorgonic Guardian can't). The combo simulator adds a going-first line, a going-second line, and the classic Gorgonic Guardian combo.
newCards: Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory

updates.title: Predaplant - Daredevil Tributes Protected Bosses and Eats the Backrow
updates.description: Beyond the Brave gives Predaplant a Level 6 Fusion that can also be summoned from the Extra Deck by Tributing a monster with a Predator Counter, even your opponent's, together with a "Predaplant" you control. That Tribute doesn't target and starts no chain. On the turn it's Special Summoned, Daredevil destroys one Spell or Trap for each monster with a Predator Counter. A new Daredevil tab covers both ways to summon it, the Super Polymerization synergy, which Branded cards can and can't summon it, a "Can you summon it?" checker, and the rulings. Three new lines in the combo simulator: a two-card going-second break, an opponent's-turn Predaplanning and Super Polymerization ambush, and a Branded Lubellion line. The Thorns of Violet Poison tab is corrected too: Thorns can only target a monster named Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, so its OTK guide is rebuilt around the original dragon and added to the simulator as line 6.

updates.title: Sacred Beast - Sacred Beasts Skyfall Shields the Reveals and Opens the Illusion Gate
updates.description: Beyond the Brave gives the Chaos Origins Sacred Beasts a Quick-Play Spell with three effects. It negates a card your opponent activates in response to a "Sacred Beast" monster's effect, adds Illusion Gate to destroy every monster they control, or shuffles 3 "Sacred Beast" Traps back into the Deck to destroy a card. A new Beyond the Brave tab adds a checker for what Skyfall can and can't stop, a table of which Sacred Beast cards count (the original trio doesn't), the Skyfall package for the deck, and three lines in the combo simulator: an Ash-proof going-first opener, a going-second Illusion Gate OTK, and an Abyss line that ends on two interruptions.

updates.title: Toon - Cartoon Shade Adds Toon Dark Magician Girl and Bounces Two Cards
updates.description: Beyond the Brave gives Toon a Level 1 DARK Illusion that Special Summons itself for free while any monster that can't be Normal Summoned is face-up, including your opponent's Extra Deck monsters. It adds Toon Dark Magician Girl, and when it's Tributed for her summon it returns 2 cards on the field to the hand, so she can attack directly that same turn. A new tab adds a search map of which cards find Cartoon Shade and what it finds, a protection checker for Toon Kingdom and Toon Bookmark, a table of which classic Toon cards work with it, and three TCG lines in the combo simulator: Sorcerer of the Swamp into Horned Saurus, a going-second Toon Bookmark bounce, and the Black Stone playbook with Shade added.

updates.title: Artmage - Theorealized Medius Calls Diactorus Straight From the Extra Deck
updates.description: Beyond the Brave brings Medius back as a Power Patron in his own right. Theorealized Medius Special Summons itself from the hand next to any Power Patron card and adds a Theorealize Spell. After that, any monster banished face-up lets it add an Ars Magna card, or banish itself to call Artmage Diactorus or DoomZ Break - Diactorus from the Extra Deck. A new Beyond the Brave tab adds an interactive map of every family it connects to, a banish checker, the rulings, the Medius saga, and three lines in the combo simulator: an Artmage board with an Impasto hand-off, a going-second Ars Magna break with DoomZ Break - Diactorus, and a pure Medius line through Theorealize and Past Lull.

updates.title: Power Patron - Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron Grows With Every Arrow
updates.description: Beyond the Brave gives Medius a Link-3 form whose three arrows all point down. Mediclius gains an effect for each monster it points to: at 1 it negates your opponent's face-up monsters and halves their ATK, at 2 it is unaffected by their activated effects, and at 3 it can banish itself and every card they control on their turn. A new Tactical Operations tab adds an arrow planner with battle math for the 9000 ATK Ars Magna turn, three combo lines in the combo simulator from Medius the Pure plus Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite (going second, going first, and a Purification Power Patron summon on the opponent's turn), the rulings, and the counterplay.

updates.title: Invoked - De Anima and Invocation - "Grail" Fuse With Your Deck and Your Opponent's Board
updates.description: Beyond the Brave gives Aleister two new cards. Invoked De Anima destroys all of your opponent's Extra Deck monsters or all their Spells and Traps when it's Special Summoned, then banishes itself to negate a GY effect and Special Summon an Aleister from your Deck. Invocation - "Grail" Fusion Summons an Invoked with one material from your Deck, or with one of your opponent's face-up monsters, but no card can search it. A new Beyond the Brave tab adds a table of every Invoked that Grail can summon, the ways to summon De Anima, the rulings, and three lines in the combo simulator: a Deck-fusion Mechaba, an opponent's-turn De Anima through Invocation - "Sword", and a going-second Meltdown break.

updates.title: Dark Time Wizard - Joey Wheeler's Gambles Become a Deck
updates.description: A new guide for Joey Wheeler's cards. The Classic Analysis tab covers Time Wizard, the dice, Thousand Dragon and the rest of his Battle City deck. The Beyond the Brave tab has an interactive gallery of the ten new cards: Swiftwind Panther Warrior, Alligator's Dragon Knight, Dark Time Wizard, Graceful & Skull Dice, Sleepy Scapegoats, Foolish Graverobber, Reversal Box, Revenge of the Paper Dolls, Crow, the Carrion Cutpurse and Just Flip a Coin. It adds a Chance Lab with the real odds of every coin and die, a going-first Jinzo lock, a going-second line for each call of the coin that ends in Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed either way, and all of it in the combo simulator.

updates.title: Jinzo - Energy Shocker Locks Out Only Your Opponent's Traps
updates.description: Beyond the Brave gives Jinzo a Level 7 retrain that destroys every Trap your opponent controls when it's summoned and gains 300 ATK for each. While another monster that mentions Dark Time Wizard is on your field or in your GY, your opponent can't activate Traps at all, including from the hand and GY. A new tab covers which classic Jinzo cards still work with it, an interactive lock checker, meta-counter notes, and three combo lines in the combo simulator: Sleepy Scapegoats, Alligator's Dragon Knight, and a classic Jinzo - Jector line.

updates.title: Number - Number 104: Masquerade V Joins the Catalog
updates.description: Beyond the Brave brings back Vector's Rank 4. Masquerade V detaches to add any Barian's Spell or Trap, and the Xyz Monster summoned on top of it makes your opponent banish 5 cards of their choice or lose the top 10 cards of their Deck. A new tab adds an Xyz profile with every Rank-Up route (V Umbral Horror, both Barian's Force Spells and the overlay into CXyz Hope Chaos Barian Dragon), the full Number 104 line, what it can add to your hand, two lines in the combo simulator including a Seventh Tachyon start for Number decks, the rulings, and its Genesys cost.

updates.title: Doriado - Elemental Saga Doriado Pulls What Your GY Is Missing
updates.description: Beyond the Brave gives Doriado a Level 7 LIGHT Spellcaster with no Ritual Spell and no Summoning condition. With three Attributes among the monsters in your GY, she Special Summons herself and any GY monster from your hand, then Special Summons a monster with a missing Attribute from your Deck, and neither player can respond to either effect. A new tab adds an interactive Attribute planner, three combo lines in the combo simulator (Invoked, Elementsaber and a going-second Chaos Angel), the rulings, and how she works with Mistress, Dark and Grace Doriado.

updates.title: Garbage - Garbage Golem Joins Dr. Faker's Scrap Heap
updates.description: A new guide for Dr. Faker's Garbage cards. Garbage Golem, from Beyond the Brave, Special Summons itself off Garbage Lord's 0 ATK, destroys any card by revealing three Xyz Monsters with different Ranks, and detaches a material from the GY to revive a 0-stat monster. The guide covers Garbage Ogre, Garbage Lord and the Heart-eartH Numbers, a going-first K9-66X "Jacks" line, a going-second two-removal line, Golem's Umbral Horror and Resonator lines, and the Xyz Monsters it works with.

updates.title: Endymion - Verre, the Maid of Endymion Turns Any Spell Into a Free Level 4
updates.description: Beyond the Brave brings Verre to the TCG. Her name makes her an Endymion card, so Spell Power Mastery searches her, and she is always treated as a Witchcrafter card. Any Spell activated earlier in the turn lets her Special Summon herself, including the Pendulum Scale you set anyway, and she searches Witchcrafter Creation or Magical Dimension, one more Spell for your counters. A new Beyond the Brave tab covers the one-Spell line into Verre and Genni, the Maid of Endymion, the rulings, and how many copies to run.

updates.title: Witchcrafter - Verre, the Maid of Endymion Starts the Coven Without a Normal Summon
updates.description: The young Madame Verre joins Witchcrafter from the Endymion side. She is always treated as a Witchcrafter card, so Witchcrafter Creation searches her and Schmietta, Genni and Vice-Madame can summon her from the Deck. After any Spell she Special Summons herself with no discard or Tribute, then adds a Witchcrafter Spell/Trap. The new Beyond the Brave tab walks through Empire of Endymion into Verre, Genni, Schmietta and Madame Verre with the Normal Summon still unused.

updates.title: Destiny HERO - Dark City at Midnight Turns One Card Into Dreadnought Master
updates.description: Beyond the Brave gives Destiny HERO five cards based on Aster Phoenix's GX deck. Doom Overlord searches the new Field Spell, Dark City at Midnight searches Dreadnought Servant, and Servant destroys the city to summon Dreadmaster from the Deck as if by Clock Tower Prison. Tributing Dreadmaster brings out Dreadnought Master, which adds 2 cards. A new tab walks through that line, extends it into Destroyer Phoenix Enforcer and Destro-Dogma, and shows where Dreadmaster clashes with the Vision HERO core.

updates.title: Barian's - Chaos Xyz of the Seven Emperors
updates.description: A new guide for the Barian's cards from Beyond the Brave. V Umbral Horror ranks Number 104: Masquerade V into Number C104 from the Graveyard, then CXyz Hope Chaos Barian Dragon stacks on any Number C101 to C107 and stops your opponent from searching. Barian's Seventh Untopia limits both players to two non-Number Extra Deck summons a turn, and Barian's Seal protects the board with a Counter Trap negation.

updates.title: Clown Crew - Cappello Gives the Troupe Its Pendulum
updates.description: Beyond the Brave gives Clown Crew its first Pendulum Monster. From the Pendulum Zone, Cappello sends Finale to the GY and Special Summons itself, so one card now reaches Biancaviso. When it is Tributed, it summons the next performer from the Deck or Extra Deck, or shuffles every Pendulum Monster on the field and in both face-up Extra Decks into the Deck. A new Cappello tab covers the one-card line, the summoning lock and deck-building.

updates.title: Chaos - Chaospawn Bishop Makes Chaos Archfiend From One Card
updates.description: Chaospawn Bishop, from Beyond the Brave, Special Summons a second copy of itself that becomes LIGHT, so one Normal Summon gives Chaos Archfiend its exact materials: a LIGHT Tuner and a DARK non-Tuner. The new tab also covers the lock that comes with it, which shuts off the classic P.U.N.K. and Zombie Vampire line, and why the LIGHT copy doesn't unlock Chaos Angel's LIGHT protection.

updates.title: Blitzclique - Overvolt, the Search Trigger That Comes Back
updates.description: Beyond the Brave gives Blitzclique a Normal Spell that destroys a face-up card with no once-per-turn limit and returns from the GY whenever a Blitzclique card's effect destroys a card. A new tab covers its card text, a going-second line with Surge and Emi, the ways to reach it, and why it stays out of other Thunder and Machine decks.

updates.title: Ars Magna - The Great Work of the Power Patrons
updates.description: A five-card engine for Power Patron decks debuts in Beyond the Brave. Its three Level 8 monsters banish themselves from the hand to search, return from banishment on every Link Summon, and turn Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron into repeatable removal on the opponent's turn.
updates.featuredCard: Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite
newCards: Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite
Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification
Ars Magna the Division and the Union

updates.title: Archfiend - Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity Bridges the Court and Light and Darkness
updates.description: Beyond the Brave retrains Black Skull Dragon as a Main Deck Level 9 DARK Dragon that carries the Archfiend name, so Royal Archfiend, Archfiend Heiress and Matador Archfiend can all search it. It summons itself on either turn by discarding a Quick-Play or Ritual Spell, and every Archfiend Ritual Spell has a Graveyard effect that pays that cost back. Its text also names Light and Darkness Ritual, which plugs it into Mind Shuffle and the Chaos Bridge build. A new Cross-Engine tab covers it alongside its Red-Eyes partner, Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed.
updates.featuredCard: Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity
newCards: Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity

updates.title: Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed Gives Red-Eyes a Boss Without Red-Eyes Fusion
updates.description: Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed comes out of the Extra Deck by Tributing a monster on either field in any turn Dark Time Wizard destroyed something, so losing the coin toss still summons it. It ignores the opponent's activated Spells and monster effects and revives a Level 8 or lower monster on summon; bringing back Jinzo - Energy Shocker shuts off Traps as well. Red-Eyes Fusion can make it, but its summon lock blanks the revival. The new support panel also covers its Archfiend partner, Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity.
newCards: Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity

updates.title: Angelechy - The Endgame Expansion
updates.description: Beyond the Brave adds seven Angelechy cards, including the archetype's first DARK piece. Endgame Problem and Verdict scale with the number of pieces on the board, Opposition deploys a piece onto your opponent's side of the field, and at five or more pieces Verdict banishes every card your opponent controls.

updates.title: Crystron - Halqifibrax Prism Puts a Synchro Tuner on Board Early
updates.description: Crystron Halqifibrax Prism is a legal successor to the Forbidden Link-2. It cheats a Tuner out of the Extra Deck with its effects intact, up to the combined original Levels of its material, and banishes itself on the opponent's turn for three Level 1 WATER Machine Tokens. Cheating out Crystron Quandax on your own turn is what finally makes Crystron Phoenix assemble in a pure build.

updates.title: Dracoslayer Finally Gets an Endboard: Wind Unicorn Parallel
updates.description: Wind Unicorn Parallel, the Dracoslayer hands the archetype the Majespecter Unicorn - Kirin bounce with a wider target range, and prints it with the Dracoslayer name so Majesty Pegasus can search it. The protection only switches on when it is Pendulum Summoned, so the line routes it through the face-up Extra Deck rather than summoning it straight out of the scale.

updates.title: Galaxy-Eyes - Antimatter Dragon Is the Legal Dark Matter
updates.description: Galaxy-Eyes Antimatter Dragon is the LIGHT rebuild of the Forbidden Number 95: Galaxy-Eyes Dark Matter Dragon, with the deck dump moved out of the summon and into the Battle Phase. Its alternative condition stacks it on any Xyz Monster holding three or more materials, so the deck's Rank 8 line finally climbs to a 4000 ATK Rank 9 that attacks monsters twice. Battle damage is halved while it holds material, and with no Battle Phase to grant attacks in it cannot legally activate anything going first.

updates.title: Relinquished - Nightmare-Eyes Restrict Drops the Named Materials
updates.description: Nightmare-Eyes Restrict is the first "Eyes Restrict" Fusion that does not list Relinquished as material. It asks for 2 monsters with different Types among Fiend, Illusion and Spellcaster, equips an opponent's monster without targeting on Special Summon or after it battles, cannot be destroyed in battle, and forces every attack onto itself. The catch is the Type line, because the classic all-Spellcaster lineup cannot make a legal pair, so the deck now has to carry an Illusion body such as Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion or Nightmare Apprentice.

updates.title: Blackwing - Kusanagi Fills the Level 9 Rung
updates.description: Magnificent Monsters finally prints Assault Blackwing - Kusanagi the Gathering Storm, an ARC-V anime card held back for over a decade. It is a direct translation of its anime text, so it gains the total original ATK of the Synchro Monsters used as material, attacks every monster the opponent controls, and carries no defensive clause at all.
updates.featuredCard: Assault Blackwing - Kusanagi the Gathering Storm
newCards: Assault Blackwing - Kusanagi the Gathering Storm

updates.title: Code Talker - Integration Reaches an OTK the Deck Could Not
updates.description: Yusaku's signature Link-3 is printed a third time as Decode Talker Integration, trading the original's reactive negate for a Quick Effect Extra Deck dump and a double-attack clause. Neo Tempest Terahertz still does the negate job for free, but Integration survives the hand traps that stop a Link-5.

updates.title: Cyberse - Integration, Code Magician and Contract Witch
updates.description: Three cards from the same wave rewrite how the Cyberse pile opens. Decode Talker Integration and Cyberse Code Magician steer it away from the rigid, fragile Extra Link toward a shorter line that survives interruption, and Cyberse Contract Witch searches the Ritual half off any two monsters of the same Type.

updates.title: Dark Magician - The Pharaoh's Servant Wave
updates.description: Dark Magical Curtain summons from the Deck without touching your Normal Summon, so Magician's Rod stays live and the turn opens a full card ahead. Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant carries its own board wipe and reads as "Dark Magician" in the graveyard for Eternal Soul and Magician's Salvation. The deck stops defending a fortress and starts opening on a single Quick-Play Spell.

updates.title: Djinn - Gagaga Magic Names the Wrong Half
updates.description: Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic is the first card in the game to hand the Djinn name a real Main Deck engine, because it names "Djinn" in its Xyz clause. It also does nothing whatsoever for the Djinn of Rituals, since the Japanese name majin covers two card pools that share nothing else.

updates.title: Dododo - Tempo Without the Normal Summon
updates.description: Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic summons itself and a partner out of the hand or graveyard, matches their Levels for you, and puts an Xyz Monster on the board before the opponent can answer the Normal Summon that used to be the whole plan. The Dododo half of the Onomat family always had the bodies and never the tempo.

updates.title: Elemental HERO - The Favorite HERO Paradigm
updates.description: Favorite HERO Shining Flare Wingman and Favorite HERO Flame Wingman are always treated as "Elemental HERO" cards, and that single clause is the whole point. It makes Super Polymerization live underneath the deck's own HERO locks, turns the Battle Phase into an active combo window, and staples a Pot of Avarice onto a 3500 ATK body.

updates.title: End of the World - Ruler Turns the Boss Into the Starter
updates.description: Ruler of the End of the World reveals itself in hand, pays 2000 LP and banishes a Ritual Spell straight out of the Deck, then applies that spell to Ritual Summon itself. A second 2000 LP wipes the field and lifts it to 5900 ATK. Its name only reads Demise, King of Armageddon in the hand and on the field, so Breaking of the World triggers but Pre-Preparation of Rites and Cycle of the World's graveyard recovery cannot see it at all.
updates.link: pages/End of the World Deck Analysis.html#tab-2026
updates.featuredCard: Ruler of the End of the World
newCards: Ruler of the End of the World

updates.title: Gagaga - A Hand Starter and an Opponent-Turn Xyz
updates.description: Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic kicks off combos straight from the hand with no Normal Summon and no field requirement. Gagaga Girl - Cell Phone Subtraction answers the opponent's Extra Deck summon by Xyz Summoning on their turn, and drops a monster's ATK to 0 whenever it is detached.

updates.title: Gogogo - Gagaga Magic Fixes Both Old Problems
updates.description: Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic hands Gogogo a Normal-Summon-free starter that fixes the archetype's two oldest problems at once: the choke point on the Normal Summon, and the mismatched Levels that made half the monster line-up brick.

updates.title: Junk - Starjunk Synchron Builds a Second Ladder
updates.description: For a decade the deck resolved Junk Speeder or scooped. Starjunk Synchron substitutes for any "Synchron" Tuner and revives a monster with its effects negated, giving Junk a second Synchro ladder that does not pass through the one card every opponent holds a hand trap for.

updates.title: Kuriboh - Multiply! and Sabatiel LV10
updates.description: The fluffballs get their first genuinely proactive cards. Kuriboh - Multiply! compresses the old Kuriboh-plus-Multiply pairing into a single Level 1 body that summons itself from the hand and tutors off the archetype's own 300/200 stat line, while Winged Kuriboh Sabatiel LV10 turns a famously unplayable Level 10 into a hand-revealed Fusion tutor and an opponent-turn burn finisher.

updates.title: Majespecter - Wind Unicorn Parallel Answers the Cards Kirin Never Could
updates.description: Wind Unicorn Parallel, the Dracoslayer copies Kirin's Level 6 WIND Spellcaster statline and Scale 2 exactly, then rewrites the bounce. It targets any card the opponent controls rather than only a monster, and its own half of the cost is any Pendulum Monster Card you control, scales included. In the Pendulum Zone it Special Summons itself or trades itself for a starter stranded in your other scale, which retires Archfiend Eccentrick. The catch is that its untargetable and indestructible clause only applies while it is a Pendulum Summoned card, so every practical way of cheating it out leaves it exposed.

updates.title: Malefic - Force and Paradigm Shift, Redesigned
updates.description: Both cards spent fifteen years locked in anime-only status after Bonds Beyond Time, and Konami rebuilt them from scratch rather than translating them. Malefic Paradigm Shift fires out of the hand on either turn for half your Life Points, and together the pair fixes the Field Spell you had to draw and the originals you had to brick on.

updates.title: Number - Emissary of Light Joins the Roster
updates.description: Konami spent 2026 modernising the ace monsters of the first six anime series, and Yuma Tsukumo's turn produced a brand new Rank 4 Utopia. Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light is the first real-world "Number" to carry the anime battle immunity clause, and the cheapest competitive "Number" boss the archetype has ever had.

updates.title: Odd-Eyes - The Four Heavenly Dragons Retrain
updates.description: A second, larger 2026 wave retrained all four ARC-V Dimension Dragons at once, and the one that matters most sits in the Main Deck. Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon of the Four Heavenly Dragons turns the archetype's original ace from an End Phase searcher into a Main Phase engine piece and a real win condition, at the cost of the most awkward restriction the deck has had to sequence around.
updates.featuredCard: Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon of the Four Heavenly Dragons
newCards: Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon of the Four Heavenly Dragons

updates.title: Pendulum Magician - Horoscope and Starfrost Open Without the Normal Summon
updates.description: Four cards in this wave carry the word Magician and only two of them are Pendulum Monsters. Horoscope Sorcerer, the Stargazer Magician summons itself off a discard, tutors a 2500 ATK Pendulum, then destroys itself to trigger Astrograph Sorcerer, the Starfrost Magician out of the hand. The pair costs neither the Normal Summon nor the Pendulum Summon. Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic and Cyberse Code Magician both lock the deck out of its own summons and belong in the decks they were written for.

updates.title: Pendulum Pile - Overframe Retrains Pull Two Ways
updates.description: Two cards land in the same wave and pull the Pile in opposite directions. Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon of the Four Heavenly Dragons finally gives the strategy a Main Phase search but charges a lock for it, while Master Spirit Tech Force - Pendulum Ruler arrives with its anime-only material requirements stripped out, handing every Pendulum deck a generic, destruction-proof Towers that freezes the Battle Phase outright.
updates.featuredCard: Master Spirit Tech Force - Pendulum Ruler
newCards: Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon of the Four Heavenly Dragons
Master Spirit Tech Force - Pendulum Ruler

updates.title: Performapal - Horoscope Sorcerer Rewrites the Opening Act
updates.description: Yuya's opening act finally got a rewrite. The original Stargazer Magician sat in the scale and waited for something to happen to it, while Horoscope Sorcerer, the Stargazer Magician summons itself, tutors a 2500 ATK boss, destroys one of your own Pendulum cards on purpose, and still holds a Spell negate in the scale. Performapal also now has its own entry in the archetype index.

updates.title: P Series - Fancy Ball Makes the Trio a Quartet
updates.description: For years the series was a trio. W:P Fancy Ball is the first member that is not a cheap utility body: a fully generic Link-3 built to be summoned on the opponent's turn off I:P Masquerena, so its monster negate is live the moment it lands. Get the timing wrong and you have a 2400 ATK vanilla.

updates.title: Stardust - Victim Sanctuary Protects the Combo, Not the Board
updates.description: Every previous Stardust boss protected the board and did nothing about the reason the deck actually lost, which was a hand trap landing before a board existed. Stardust Dragon - Victim Sanctuary only turns its negation on when the opponent responds to something you activated, which makes it a combo shield rather than a boss monster.

updates.title: Synchron - Starjunk Synchron and Synchro Emergency
updates.description: Starjunk Synchron gives the deck a second Synchro ladder that does not pass through Junk Speeder, and negates whatever it brings back. Synchro Emergency lets you Synchro Summon during the opponent's first turn off their own board, which is the archetype's first genuine turn-zero play.

updates.title: Utopia - Emissary of Light Simply Does Not Die
updates.description: Yuma's ace finally got its modern retrain, and it is not the boss the archetype expected. Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light adds no negate and no removal. What it adds is the one thing every previous Rank 4 Utopia lacked: a body that does not die in battle, and a shield it can hand to something else while it stands there.

updates.title: Zubaba - Closing a Decade-Old Fault Line
updates.description: Three of Zubaba's four original Main Deck monsters are Level 3, and its only Extra Deck member is a Rank 4, so for over a decade the archetype could not perform its own Xyz Summon without borrowing a level-fixer. Gagaga Magician - Gagaga Magic closes that gap from the hand, in one card, with no Normal Summon and no board requirement.

updates.title: Suggest Edits Directly on Any Deck Page
updates.description: Every combo walkthrough, strengths/weaknesses list, and card note now has a [suggest edit] control right on the page — rewrite it in place with a live preview, or flag a specific error. Submissions are moderated before going live, and a [history] control lets you see every past version alongside the original AI draft. See the Contributing page for details.

updates.title: Combo Simulator - New Archetypes & a Sharper Selector
updates.description: The interactive JSON-driven combo simulator expands to D/D, Gishki, and Primite, while Fire King and every existing page gets a redesigned themed combo-selector dropdown with per-archetype accent colors.

updates.title: Speedroid - Darumaknocker Fixes the Rubber Band Choke Point
updates.description: Legendary ARC-V Decks' Speedroid Darumaknocker searches Speedroid Clear Wing Wonder straight off a Synchro or Link transition, finally giving Yugo's toy-themed Synchro swarm a searchable, multi-target Trap that also resets Crystal Clear Wing's negate.

updates.title: Odd-Eyes - Solblaze & Override Dragons Complete the Toolbox
updates.description: Legendary ARC-V Decks arms Odd-Eyes with its first dedicated Link Monster, Odd-Eyes Override Dragon, and a new Synchro Tuner, Odd-Eyes Solblaze Dragon, finally letting the archetype coherently use Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Link, and Pendulum together while patching its historic weakness to mid-combo handtraps.

updates.title: Lunalight - Scarlet Tiger's Insurance
updates.description: Legendary ARC-V Decks' Lunalight Scarlet Tiger converts an opponent's negation of a starter into free extension, Special Summoning itself off any Lunalight activation and adding Polymerization when the opponent interrupts, giving the deck handtrap resilience it never had.

updates.title: Swordsoul - Three Champions Unite
updates.description: The Three Brave Swordsouls arrives in Chaos Origins as the bridge that was always missing — a Level 8 Synchro that searches Spellcasters with equal ATK/DEF and negates effects when Albaz or Ecclesia rests in the graveyard.

updates.title: Fallen of Albaz - Champions Converge
updates.description: The Three Brave Swordsouls bridges the Albaz and Swordsoul storylines mechanically — a Level 8 Synchro that unlocks both Spellcaster searches and effect negation with destruction when Albaz is in the graveyard.

updates.title: Mystical Beast of the Forest - Cerynemesia
updates.description: Cerynemesia, Mystical Beast of the Forest steps out of legend in Chaos Origins — a Level 2 Beast that banishes a Beast from hand to special summon a matching EARTH Beast from Deck or GY, backed by a mandatory attack redirect.
updates.link: pages/Mystical Beast of the Forest Deck Analysis.html
updates.featuredCard: Cerynemesia, Mystical Beast of the Forest
newCards: Cerynemesia, Mystical Beast of the Forest

updates.title: Elfnote - June Pride's Debut
updates.description: Chaos Origins delivers exactly what Elfnote needed — June Pride locks attacks to the center column and tags out into three monsters, while Quatrain of Succession generates flexible-level Tuner tokens to hit any Synchro target.

updates.title: Clown Crew - Dristy & Finale
updates.description: Chaos Origins gives Clown Crew its missing combo payoff — Dristy turns Tribute Summoned monsters into double-attackers and resets both Link zones or reshuffles both hands, while Finale mass-destroys at the cost of discarding.

updates.title: Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness
updates.description: The Chaos Origins set reimagines Black Luster Soldier as a modern Ritual boss — immune to battle destruction and untargetable by activated effects, it banishes on summon and gains 1500 ATK to attack twice after destroying a monster.

updates.title: Chaos - Light and Darkness Reborn
updates.description: Chaos Origins reshapes the Chaos strategy with the full Light and Darkness Ritual engine — Corrupted Ritual Records searches any monster in the suite, unlocking more consistent access to Black Luster Soldier and Magician of Black Chaos alongside every existing Chaos engine.
newCards: Black Chaos the Ultimate Magical Swordsman

updates.title: Invoked - Paradigm Shift
updates.description: Ten new Chaos Origins cards transform Invoked from a fragile Normal Summon engine into resilient midrange control — Aleister the Reminiscent frees the deck from its choke point, while Hyperinvoked Aeon rips the opponent's Extra Deck.
newCards: Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law
Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice

updates.title: Sacred Beasts - Phantasmal Ascension
updates.description: Eleven new Chaos Origins cards rebuild the Sacred Beast strategy from the ground up — retrains of Uria, Hamon, and Raviel with a complete standalone engine that summons all three gods in one decisive turn.
newCards: Inferno of the Sacred Beasts - Uria, Lord of Searing Flames
Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder

Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts

updates.title: S-Force - Jurisdiction Expanded
updates.description: Five new Chaos Origins cards solve every historical S-Force weakness — Signify provides a resource-positive Normal Summon, Nightcatcher cheats out boss monsters, and Mystify locks the opponent's monster effects.

updates.title: Melffy - Godmommy's Arrival
updates.description: Five new Chaos Origins cards transform Melffy from passive defender to active threat — Rabbys enables turn-zero Fusion plays, Joyful Surprise bounces boards, and Godmommy clears the field with five detach materials.

updates.title: Phantom Knights - Requiem's Echo
updates.description: Five new Chaos Origins cards overhaul the Phantom Knights engine — new main deck starters, a Rank 3 bridge, and Rank-Up-Magic Requiem restore the dark warriors to competitive relevance.

updates.title: Power Patron - Chaos Origins Breakthrough
updates.description: Three new Chaos Origins cards solve Power Patron's core fragility — Purification Power Patron bridges the engine, Vilaea suppresses opponent responses, and Shade of the Final Hour delivers devastating off-turn disruption.
newCards: Power Patron Shade of the Final Hour

updates.title: Archfiend - Chaos Origins Reinforcements
updates.description: Skull Archfiend of Chaos bridges two royal courts — a Level 6 homage to Summoned Skull that searches the Archfiend Ritual engine and fuels the Light and Darkness Ritual combo lines alongside Archfiend's Origin.

updates.title: Light and Darkness Ritual - Legends Reborn
updates.description: The icons of the original manga return in Chaos Origins — Black Luster Soldier and Magician of Black Chaos are reimagined as modern Ritual bosses with a complete 11-card support engine built around the new Light and Darkness Ritual spell.
updates.link: pages/Light and Darkness Ritual Deck Analysis.html

updates.title: Angelechy - Chess Pieces on the Board
updates.description: A chess-themed Synchro archetype debuts in Chaos Origins — Angelechy monsters shift between Monster Zones and Spell & Trap Zones, controlling columns and locking the opponent's Special Summons.

updates.title: Blitzclique - Sky Scavengers Debut
updates.description: A brand-new Thunder archetype crashes into Chaos Origins — Blitzclique's sky-dwelling scavengers reveal themselves from the hand to destroy, swarm, and loot cards in one explosive chain.

updates.title: Artmage - Theorealize Past Lull
updates.description: Chaos Origins delivers the missing piece — Theorealize Past Lull summons Medius the Pure through any Artmage, DoomZ, or Elfnote board, ending the era of brittle engine isolation.

updates.title: Discord Login & Personal Replay Library
updates.description: Link your Discord account to unlock your personal Replay Library — track every duel, review your win/loss record across archetypes, and manage your replays from a dedicated profile page. Replays can be kept private or shared with the community. Sign in with Discord on the Replay Analyzer to get started.

updates.title: Dragunity - The Lord Rides Forth
updates.description: Five new Dragunity cards arrive in Battles of Legend: Glorious Gallery — Quirinus, Falchion, Divine Wind, Knight Areus, and Lord Georgius reshape the archetype's combo ceiling.

updates.title: Constellar - Celestial Convergence
updates.description: Six new Constellar and Tellarknight cards land in Battles of Legend: Glorious Gallery — Cygnian, Castor, Delteros, Ω7, Stellarnova Binding, and Tohushaddoll Grysta deliver a turn-skip win condition.

updates.title: Shaddoll - The Void Tears Open
updates.description: The curtain tears. From the void step Meshachrer and Wendikuruhu — new Fusions forged by Lev Shaddoll Fusion, with Void Unleashing ready to shatter any response.

updates.title: Masked HERO - Fountain Arrives
updates.description: The HERO roster flows ever wider — Masked HERO Fountain surges in, bringing a fresh current of power to every transformation.

updates.title: Darklord - Fallen Angel in Darkness
updates.description: Even angels fall. Fallen Angel in Darkness plunges into the Darklord arsenal, turning the heavens' cruelty into a punishing new trap.

updates.title: Junk - Overdrive Unlocked
updates.description: The junkyard roars back to life. Junk Armor suits up, Junk Meister steps onto the field, and Over Tuning pushes the Synchron engine past its limits.

updates.title: Resonator - Champion's Pulse
updates.description: Feel the beat. Champion's Pulse reverberates through the Resonator engine, turning every heartbeat into fuel for Red Dragon Archfiend's next assault.

updates.title: Gagaga - Now You See Them...
updates.description: Blink and you'll miss it. Gagaga Illusion conjures threats from thin air while Gagaga Escape vanishes from danger — together they make the Xyz game harder to answer than ever.

updates.title: Utopia - Endless Bond
updates.description: Yuma's spirit endures. Endless Bond stitches together the hope of every Utopia play, ensuring the fight never truly ends.

updates.title: Predaplant - Thorns of Violet Poison
updates.description: The garden bares its teeth. Thorns of Violet Poison coils around the opponent's field, spreading Predator Counters and promising a slow, venomous end.

updates.title: Endymion - The Prince Ascends
updates.description: The kingdom remembers its prince. Genni tends the court, Empire of Endymion raises the walls, Arrow of Regulus takes aim — and at the throne sits Regulus, ready to reclaim every Spell Counter owed.

updates.title: Neo-Spacian - Miracle Ejector
updates.description: Miracle Ejector joins the Neo-Spacian toolkit as a new piece of support.

updates.title: Lore Archive - Thematic Intros on Every Page
updates.description: Every archetype page now opens with a Lore Archive — a thematic, story-driven introduction written in the voice of each archetype's world, sitting between the deck resources dock and the Executive Summary.

updates.title: Clown Crew - New Theme Debut
updates.description: The Clown Crew circus arrives with a full troupe of monsters and Extra Deck performers including Biancaviso, Diabolo, and more.

updates.title: /Assault Mode - Red Nova Ascension
updates.description: Red Nova Dragon/Assault Mode surges in, with Crimson Call providing new combo support for the Assault Mode strategy.

updates.title: Archfiend - Doom Regina's Reign
updates.description: Doom Regina Archfiend seizes the throne, backed by the new Archfiend Usurpation Spell.

updates.title: Artmage - Impasto Recapture
updates.description: Artmage Impasto -Recapture- and a new Power Patron crossover piece push the Artmage engine further.

updates.title: Charmer - Quartet in Bloom

updates.title: DoomZ - Graflario & A.D.R.A.S.T.E.I.A.

updates.title: Elemental HERO - H-E-R-O Flash!
updates.description: H-E-R-O Flash! delivers a powerful new Spell to the HERO toolkit, joined by Miracle Ejector as a new piece of Elemental HERO support.

updates.title: Elfnote - Regina's Arrival

updates.title: Enneacraft - Reset, exapatisIA & Atil.SPIA

updates.title: Fairy Tail - Massive Expansion

updates.title: GMX - Laboratory Overflow
